researchHypothesis.narrative: Published co-primary results support a plausible regulatory efficacy case. Clinically meaningful magnitude, safety and monitoring requirements, source-data discrepancies, final locked SAP, and a filed/accepted exact nHCM application remain unadjudicated.

gates.title: Exact NCT and protocol identity crosschecked
gates.detail: NCT06081894 / CY 6033 / EU 2023-505797-15-00 crosswalk; registry phase is not signed off

gates.title: Versioned original Phase III protocol captured and hashed
gates.detail: 90-page public CY 6033 Amendment 04; hash available, independent medical review pending

gates.title: Peer-reviewed co-primary estimates and confidence intervals available
gates.detail: KCCQ-CSS +3.0 (95% CI 0.5 to 5.5); pVO2 +0.67 (95% CI 0.22 to 1.11); indexing is not a full SAP audit

gates.title: Final locked prespecified statistical analysis plan authenticated
gates.detail: Final signed SAP, amendment dates and primary multiplicity graph not obtained

gates.title: Full primary sensitivity, estimands and missing-data analyses audited
gates.detail: Original primary appendix/CSR, full analysis-set denominator and sensitivity results not yet independently checked

provisionalResearchScore.interpretation: Fraction of documentary research checks observed; equal checklist weights are not a validated scientific grading rubric, a treatment-effect probability, a clinical-grade recommendation or an FDA prediction.

gates.title: Sponsor's dated endpoint-redesign explanation available
gates.detail: May 2025 sponsor disclosure explains elevation of peak VO2 as a second primary endpoint; sponsor-reported regulator discussions are not verified FDA correspondence.

gates.title: Amended Phase III dual-primary protocol captured
gates.detail: Original CY 6033 Amendment 04 protocol is publicly captured with exact SHA-256; independently locked SAP remains absent.

gates.title: Both published primary endpoint estimates and confidence intervals available
gates.detail: KCCQ-CSS +3.0 points (95% CI 0.5–5.5) and peak VO2 +0.67 mL/kg/min (95% CI 0.22–1.11); this does not establish clinical importance.

gates.title: Final signed SAP confirms testing graph, endpoint hierarchy and version
gates.detail: No authenticated final locked statistical analysis plan, pre-unblinding version history or complete alpha-allocation graph.

gates.title: Clinical-important-difference and FDA endpoint acceptability independently assessed
gates.detail: Published numerical benefit is known; independent patient-meaningfulness threshold and indication-specific FDA acceptability not adjudicated.

additionalProvisionalResearchScores.interpretation: 3/5 means three endpoint DOCUMENT SOURCES available, not three favorable scientific findings or an FDA success probability.

additionalProvisionalResearchScores.label: Safety-source reconciliation documentary readiness

gates.title: Peer-reviewed original pivotal safety summary available
gates.detail: LVEF under 50% reported 27/258 versus 2/259, and all-cause serious adverse events 52/258 versus 38/259; not adjudicated causal estimates.

gates.title: Subsequent sponsor serious-heart-failure adverse-event disclosure located
gates.detail: Issuer's November 4 10-Q reports serious heart-failure adverse events 12/258 versus 3/259; differs from secondary publication 11 versus 1.

gates.title: Heart-failure SAE 11/1 versus 12/3 reconciled by definition and window
gates.detail: Safety-set cutoff, SAE definition, coding, individual events and follow-up windows remain unreconciled; absence of proof is not a negative clinical result.

gates.title: Treatment-interruption reported rates reconciled with exact denominators
gates.detail: Secondary publication prints 14 (2.7%) and 1 (0.8%); randomized denominators 258/259 do not reproduce those percentages and may not be the correct safety-set denominator.

gates.title: Complete AE tables, causality and reversibility independently assessed
gates.detail: Original blinded event coding, adverse-event line listings and prespecified reversibility analyses not independently signed off.

additionalProvisionalResearchScores.interpretation: 2/5 reflects two accessible source summaries and three unresolved reconciliation steps; it is not safety efficacy, risk score or FDA approval probability.
